title: Bills history 10/10
summary: Bill History now defaults to Today with matching stats, date chips (Yesterday / 7 days / All / Custom), a customer column, dismissible tips, and cleaner row actions with Void/Delete under a more menu.
highlights: Date chips: Today (default), Yesterday, 7 days, All, Custom — stats and table share the same range.
Customer column shows name and phone when captured on the bill.
Primary actions: reprint, thermal, rebill, WhatsApp; Void and Delete live under ⋯.
Filter tip is dismissible and remembered; Export / Print report respect active filters.
